scripts.dev:backend: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway"  "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:property" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:ticket"
scripts.start:backend: concurrently "npm run start --workspace=backend/gateway" "npm run start --workspace=backend/services/user-service" "npm run start --workspace=backend/services/property-service" "npm run start --workspace=backend/services/payment-service" "npm run start --workspace=backend/services/ai-service" "npm run start --workspace=backend/services/ticket-service"
scripts.build:backend: npm -w backend/gateway run build && npm -w backend/services/user-service run build && npm -w backend/services/property-service run build && npm -w backend/services/payment-service run build && npm -w backend/services/ai-service run build && npm -w backend/services/ticket-service run build
